title: Equationless quadratic Chabauty for non-split Cartan modular curves
summary: The aim of this article is to describe an equationless method for determining the rational points on the non-split Cartan curve $X_{\rm{ns}}^+(N)$ of prime level $N \geqslant 13$. Instead of using a projective model for the modular curve, our method uses the moduli interpretation of the curve, namely we work directly with elliptic curves and Cartan level structures. To accomplish this, we use the geometric version of the quadratic Chabauty method.
